input.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, overriding Section 2.1's no-termination language.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, since the three-year take-or-pay commitment in Section 2.1 currently leaves us with no exit. If a longer runway helps, we can move to 60 days' notice.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Section 2.1, Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without early-termination fee or other penalty, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a term.
